expected_current_version_id.description: Current widget version the improvement is based on. Required for improve operations.

generation_id.description: Idempotency key for this generation job.

generation_operation.description:
Whether to generate from scratch or improve the current source.

* `initial` - initial
* `regenerate` - regenerate
* `improve` - improve

model.description:
AI model used to generate the widget.

* `claude-haiku-4-5` - claude-haiku-4-5
* `claude-sonnet-4-6` - claude-sonnet-4-6
* `claude-sonnet-5` - claude-sonnet-5
* `claude-opus-5` - claude-opus-5

node_id.description: Stable identifier of the generated widget node.

prompt.description: Instructions for the generated widget. Initial and improvement instructions accept up to 20,000 characters; regeneration accepts complete instructions up to 50,000 characters.

short_id.description: The notebook's short_id from its URL or notebooks-list, not its UUID id.
